payload.reason: The evidence provides clear definitions and context for pivot-based baselines, including their role in transfer learning and multilingual NMT.

claims.text: Pivot-based methods are a strategy to create a source to target model by using a pivot language.
Pivot-based methods are one of the main categories of existing methods in machine translation, alongside transfer learning and multilingual NMT.
Pivoting is identified as a strong baseline that outperforms other methods in certain experiments.
Pivot-based methods can lead to computational challenges and error propagation due to their complexity.
